probes.title: Amsterdam Engine API surface
probes.detail: Check that two authenticated execution endpoints advertise the Amsterdam Engine API methods required for Glamsterdam block access lists.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-engine-api-surface
description: Check that two authenticated execution endpoints advertise the Amsterdam Engine API methods required for Glamsterdam block access lists.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-7928"]
  category: engine_api
  risk: critical
  fixture_release: tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/amsterdam.md
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: advertised-amsterdam-engine-methods
    method: engine_exchangeCapabilities
    params:
      - - engine_newPayloadV5
        - engine_getPayloadV6
        - engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV4
        - engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2
        - engine_getPayloadBodiesByRangeV2
        - engine_getBlobsV4
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          contains_all:
            - engine_newPayloadV5
            - engine_getPayloadV6
            - engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV4
            - engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2
            - engine_getPayloadBodiesByRangeV2
            - engine_getBlobsV4
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          contains_all:
            - engine_newPayloadV5
            - engine_getPayloadV6
            - engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV4
            - engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2
            - engine_getPayloadBodiesByRangeV2
            - engine_getBlobsV4

probes.title: Block access list retrieval
probes.detail: Compare the public EIP-7928 block access list for one fixed post-fork execution block.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-block-access-list-retrieval
description: Compare the public EIP-7928 block access list for one fixed post-fork execution block.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-7928"]
  category: block_access_list
  risk: critical
  fixture_release: tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/amsterdam.md
inputs:
  block:
    description: A known post-Glamsterdam execution block number or block hash.
    kind: quantity
    required: true
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: block-access-list
    method: eth_getBlockAccessList
    params: ["{{block}}"]
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result/0
          has_keys: [address, storageChanges, storageReads, balanceChanges, nonceChanges, codeChanges]
      candidate:
        - path: /result/0
          has_keys: [address, storageChanges, storageReads, balanceChanges, nonceChanges, codeChanges]

probes.title: Gas repricing estimates
probes.detail: Compare the same transactions from identical starting state under pre-Glamsterdam and Glamsterdam protocol rules.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-gas-repricing-estimate
description: Compare the same transactions from identical starting state under pre-Glamsterdam and Glamsterdam protocol rules.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-2780", "EIP-7981", "EIP-8037", "EIP-8038"]
  category: gas_repricing
  risk: high
  fixture_release: tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2780
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7981
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8038
inputs:
  sender:
    description: A funded disposable account on both targets.
    kind: address
    required: true
  recipient:
    description: An existing EOA with the same state on both targets.
    kind: address
    required: true
  block:
    description: The equivalent controlled block context on both protocol environments, in hexadecimal quantity form.
    kind: quantity
    required: true
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: shared-fork-block
    method: eth_getBlockByNumber
    params: ["{{block}}", false]
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          has_keys: [hash, number]
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          has_keys: [hash, number]
  - kind: rpc
    id: zero-value-call-exact-gas
    method: eth_createAccessList
    params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{recipient}}"
        value: "0x0"
      - "{{block}}"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result/gasUsed
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result/gasUsed
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: zero-value-call
    method: eth_estimateGas
    params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{recipient}}"
        value: "0x0"
      - "{{block}}"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: access-list-transfer
    method: eth_estimateGas
    params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
        accessList:
          - address: "{{recipient}}"
            storageKeys: []
      - "{{block}}"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true

probes.title: Malformed block access list rejection
probes.detail: Compare rejection of an invalid EIP-7928 block access list with an official Engine API fixture.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-malformed-block-access-list
description: Compare rejection of an invalid EIP-7928 block access list with an official Engine API fixture.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-7928"]
  category: engine_validation
  risk: critical
  fixture_release: tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases
inputs:
  new_payload_params:
    description: The full JSON params array from an official malformed or missing blockAccessList engine_newPayloadV5 fixture.
    kind: json
    required: true
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: reject-malformed-block-access-list
    method: engine_newPayloadV5
    params: "{{new_payload_params}}"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result/status
          equals: INVALID
      candidate:
        - path: /result/status
          equals: INVALID

probes.title: Gloas execution payload bid
probes.detail: Compare Gloas ePBS execution payload bid responses from two Builder API targets for the same proposal context.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-gloas-execution-payload-bid
description: Compare Gloas ePBS execution payload bid responses from two Builder API targets for the same proposal context.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-7732"]
  category: builder_api
  risk: critical
  fixture_release: tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0
  sources:
    - https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/apis/builder/execution_payload_bid.yaml
inputs:
  slot:
    description: The decimal Gloas slot to query.
    required: true
  parent_hash:
    description: The execution parent hash for the proposed block.
    required: true
  parent_root:
    description: The beacon parent root for the proposed block.
    required: true

    description: The BLS public key of the proposer.
    required: true

      Accept: application/json
      Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /status
          equals: 200
      candidate:
        - path: /status
          equals: 200

probes.title: EIP-7928 fork-boundary control
probes.detail: Controlled self-test proving that DCEPT detects a known EIP-7928 boundary difference.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: glamsterdam-fork-boundary-control
description: Controlled self-test proving that DCEPT detects a known EIP-7928 boundary difference.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-7928"]
  category: block_access_list
  risk: critical
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: pre-fork-versus-post-fork-bal
    method: eth_getBlockAccessList
    baseline_params:
      - "0x1"
    candidate_params:
      - "0x233f6"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /error/code
          equals: -32600
      candidate:
        - path: /result/0
          has_keys:
            - address
            - storageChanges
            - storageReads
            - balanceChanges
            - nonceChanges
            - codeChanges

probes.title: CreateX pre-signed deployment compatibility
probes.detail: Compare the current CreateX deployment transaction on Ethereum Mainnet and Platåberget. This control checks whether a fixed gas cap and the canonical CreateX address remain usable. It is not a controlled protocol differential.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: createx-presigned-deployment-compatibility
description: >-
  Compare the current CreateX deployment transaction on Ethereum Mainnet and
  Platåberget. This control checks whether a fixed gas cap and the canonical
  CreateX address remain usable. It is not a controlled protocol differential.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-8037"]
  category: deployment_tooling
  risk: high
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037
    - https://github.com/pcaversaccio/createx
inputs:
  createx_init_code:
    description: The current CreateX contract creation bytecode from the official repository.
    kind: string
    required: true
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: createx-canonical-address-code
    method: eth_getCode
    params:
      - "0xba5Ed099633D3B313e4D5F7bdc1305d3c28ba5Ed"
      - latest
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          contains_all: ["0x6080604052"]
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          equals: "0x"
  - kind: rpc
    id: createx-default-presigned-gas-cap
    method: eth_estimateGas
    params:
      - from: "0xed456e05caab11d66c4c797dd6c1d6f9a7f352b5"
        data: "{{createx_init_code}}"
        gas: "0x2dc6c0"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: createx-deployment-gas-required
    method: eth_estimateGas
    params:
      - from: "0xed456e05caab11d66c4c797dd6c1d6f9a7f352b5"
        data: "{{createx_init_code}}"
        gas: "0x2aea540"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true

probes.title: PoW faucet fresh-account transfer gas
probes.detail: Compare the gas estimate for the same 1-wei transfer to an existing account and a fresh account on Platåberget. The devnet-6 faucet configuration records a 100000 gas cap. A fresh-account transfer needs more gas under the Amsterdam gas schedule. This is a control reproducer for faucet compatibility. It is not a controlled protocol differential.
probes.yaml:
version: 1
name: powfaucet-fresh-account-transfer
description: >-
  Compare the gas estimate for the same 1-wei transfer to an existing account
  and a fresh account on Platåberget. The devnet-6 faucet configuration records
  a 100000 gas cap. A fresh-account transfer needs more gas under the
  Amsterdam gas schedule. This is a control reproducer for faucet
  compatibility. It is not a controlled protocol differential.
probe:
  upgrade: glamsterdam
  eips: ["EIP-8037"]
  category: faucet_compatibility
  risk: high
  sources:
    - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037
    - https://github.com/ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnets/issues/46
inputs:
  sender:
    description: A funded disposable sender on the target network.
    kind: address
    default: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001"
  existing_recipient:
    description: An existing account on the target network.
    kind: address
    default: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000002"
  fresh_recipient:
    description: An account with no code and no balance on the target network.
    kind: address
    default: "0x9c8f4d2e1a7b6c5d4e3f2a190817263544332211"
actions:
  - kind: rpc
    id: recipient-code-state
    method: eth_getCode
    baseline_params:
      - "{{existing_recipient}}"
      - latest
    candidate_params:
      - "{{fresh_recipient}}"
      - latest
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          equals: "0x"
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          equals: "0x"
  - kind: rpc
    id: recipient-balance-state
    method: eth_getBalance
    baseline_params:
      - "{{existing_recipient}}"
      - latest
    candidate_params:
      - "{{fresh_recipient}}"
      - latest
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: transfer-gas-by-recipient-state
    method: eth_estimateGas
    baseline_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{existing_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
    candidate_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{fresh_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
      candidate:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: faucet-100k-gas-cap
    method: eth_estimateGas
    baseline_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{existing_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
        gas: "0x186a0"
    candidate_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{fresh_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
        gas: "0x186a0"
    expect:
      baseline:
        - path: /result
          is_hex_quantity: true
  - kind: rpc
    id: faucet-transfer-at-100k
    method: eth_call
    baseline_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{existing_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
        gas: "0x186a0"
      - latest
    candidate_params:
      - from: "{{sender}}"
        to: "{{fresh_recipient}}"
        value: "0x1"
        gas: "0x186a0"
      - latest
